message.content:
Yes! The **New York Public Library (NYPL)** has an extensive collection of historical‑fiction titles across its branches and online catalogs.

### How to locate one:

| Step | What you do |
|------|-------------|
| 1️⃣ | Visit the [NYPL website](https://www.nypl.org/) |
| 2️⃣ | Click “**Catalog & Collections**” → “**Search our Catalog**.” |
| 3️⃣ | In the search bar type keywords such as *historical fiction* or add specific details like author name, title fragment, or time period. |
| 4️⃣ | Use filters on the left side – choose “Genre / Subject” → “Historical Fiction,” then narrow further by publication year, format, etc. |
| 5️⃣ | Browse results; click each entry for availability, location, and checkout options. |

If you’re looking for something particular—say a novel set during World War II—you could enter `World War II` + `historical fiction`. If you want help finding a specific title, let me know the name or author, and I’ll look it up for you right now!
